what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guatemala in Belize: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 429 Guatemalan asylum seekers in Belize, 0.3% of all asylum seekers from Guatemala.
Refugees from Guatemala, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Mexico, Canada and Spain.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Guatemala in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2008 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 453, at the end of 2018, and was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belize.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Belize only.
